Notes: ROUND AN (isometric players). Standing still, facing the ball. Each animation takes 8 rows, one per direction, in this order: east, south-east, south, south-west, west, north-west, north, north-east. First Row is the east row.
Running, toward wherever the player is going. Also used while being walked into the goal huddle.
A pass or a shot, facing the ball's way. No ball in the drawing: the game draws its own.
A sliding tackle when this player wins the ball, and the scorer's knee slide in a goal celebration.
Knocked over when this player loses the ball to a tackle.
After a goal, the scoring side cheers whenever they stand still.
